basis: Autoimmune mechanism defines this umbrella; affected exocrine organs vary across its constituent diseases.
Infantile interstitial lung disease with pulmonary infiltrates, hypoxemia and reduced lung function; inflammation alone does not establish immune-mediated disease.
Adenocarcinoma arising from colonic glandular epithelium.
Severe neurodevelopmental impairment with regression, absent speech and loss of hand skills; hyperventilation does not establish pulmonary damage.
Bilirubin neurotoxicity directly injures the neonatal brain; hepatic disease and blood-cell disease are not intrinsic to this concept.
Bartholin gland disease is confined to a female reproductive organ outside the specified axes.
Inflammatory vasculitis of brain or spinal cord vessels defines an immune-mediated CNS vascular disease.
Congenital skeletal muscular dystrophy with fixed joint contractures; the neuromuscular designation alone does not establish nerve disease.
Syndrome defined by epidermal nevi and phosphate-wasting, vitamin D-resistant rickets affecting bone mineralization.
Acute myeloid leukemia with basophilic differentiation is a blood and marrow neoplasm.
Candida infection defines the umbrella; mucosal, cutaneous and invasive forms have different organ distributions.
Inherited palmoplantar keratoderma; skin involvement reported in 14/14 patients.
Leukemic cells infiltrate the testis; leukemia supplies the haematologic axis, while testicular reproductive tissue has no axis.
Developmental delay, intellectual disability and brain abnormalities define the disorder; constipation and feeding difficulty do not establish direct gastrointestinal damage.
Peripheral nerve sheath neoplasm with cellular pleomorphism; a cutaneous location is not specified.
Glycosylation defect with defining CNS dysfunction; strabismus 7/8 and osteopenia 2/3 support involvement; liver abnormalities <30%; no established immune defect.
Neurometabolic dopamine-synthesis disorders defined by dystonia; abnormal muscle activation does not establish primary skeletal muscle disease.
Limb, hair/nail and dental malformations define syndrome; nasolacrimal obstruction is a defining feature; pinna shape alone does not establish ear dysfunction.
Systemic Francisella infection with bacteremia; bacteremia is not blood-cell disease, and myalgia does not establish muscle injury.
Inherited proximal tubulopathy with proteinuria, hypercalciuria and nephrocalcinosis; rickets and osteomalacia are variable and not established in at least 30%.
Neuroendocrine neoplasm arising in the stomach; hormonal syndromes are uncommon, and associated iron deficiency anemia is a separate disease.
Intestinal atresias/enterocolitis with combined immunodeficiency; common intrinsic liver injury independent of parenteral nutrition is not established; lymphoma is separate.
Degeneration of corticospinal pathways causes uncomplicated hereditary spastic paraplegia; secondary stiffness does not establish primary muscle disease.
Immune-mediated glomerular inflammation with polymorphonuclear leukocyte infiltration directly injures the kidney.
Loss of coordinated bladder and urethral sphincter function; an underlying neurological disorder is a separate disease.
